content_text: [1/25 @BoringBiz_] This news article is absolutely insane and probably a good glimpse into what the future of hedge funds look like in an AI driven world Coatue backed hedge fund, Epicenter, is using AI to replace massive teams of hedge fund analysts Their AI bot, Eve, is plugged into every part of the firm, including emails and every trade that the fund puts on Without any prompts, the AI bot is able to assign tasks to human analysts and write code on their behalf Eve also contains a screening tool which scours through more than 13,000 company disclosures, listens to podcasts, and summarizes news reports on specific businesses The AI bot can then generate primers and custom podcasts on behalf of the human analysts without requiring any instructions beforehand If you read this and don’t think that AI is going to impact headcount in finance, you are absolutely mistaken --- [2/25 @chikaibeh_1] @BoringBiz_ @grok how do they write article on X? --- [3/25 @Time7MDI] @BoringBiz_ zero reason for human intellect in 3 years in business due to ai. watch and see. the math checks out. --- [4/25 @atomicrabits] @BoringBiz_ Soon we will be forced to develop AI Antidotes. Its getting out of our hands real quick, massive global slavery loading? --- [5/25 @cc_video_edit] @BoringBiz_ Feels like leverage more than a full replacement right now. --- [6/25 @aanalystbro] @BoringBiz_ I guarantee you this fund will do horribly and be shut down. Coatue has a *really* bad track record doing these types of experiments. --- [7/25 @ScroogeCap] @BoringBiz_ They tryna be RenTech or what --- [8/25 @rcwillenbrock] @BoringBiz_ is eve changing how decisions get made or just making the existing process faster & cheaper --- [9/25 @chisaehawng] @BoringBiz_ curious how eve handles black swan events that arent in training data --- [10/25 @Joseph_Paul_V] @BoringBiz_ AI can analyze written and recorded documents, but in the situation where everyone has access to an AI this does not generate value only savings, as you correctly noted. AI fails to have a grasp on the material world at this time; the most important domain for humans. --- [11/25 @uv] @BoringBiz_ they should hit us up --- [12/25 @BullBrezza] @BoringBiz_ Sharp take - but here’s a tighter, punchy reply in your tone: Everyone sees efficiency. When the model breaks, there’s no human left to fix it-only prompts feeding a black box.” --- [13/25 @lucacs] @BoringBiz_ we're all just doing the same shit aren't we https://t.co/irbtIlPW9k --- [14/25 @thecleverrat] @BoringBiz_ Eh humans will always exist in investing.
